about: The prestudy drill rule, shared by its two implementations: services/prestudy.py drill_sense_ids() (tests/test_exercise_content_prestudy_reader.py) and static/js/prestudy/prestudy.js drillSenseIds() (tests/unit/prestudy-ondemand.test.js). Each case is a slice of the GET /api/tests/<id>/prestudy payload and the sorted sense ids the prime drills before the learner adds a word. A linked sense (test.vocab_sense_ids) with a senses entry is drilled when p_known < 0.75: the learner's row p, else the Zipf prior 1/(1+exp(-(1.5*(freq-ability)+ln(0.85/0.15)))), 0.3 when freq is null; ability_zipf null means 5.0.

why.1: row p 0.75 is probably_known: not drilled (strict <)
why.2: row p 0.7499: drilled; listed twice, drilled once
why.3: row p 0.2 beats the prior of a common word
why.4: row p 0.95 beats the prior of a rare word
why.10: freq 0 is a frequency, not a missing one: prior 0.003
why.11: linked and unknown but no senses entry: the page cannot show it
why.12: unknown but not linked (a question-only sense)
why.13: row p 0 wins over the prior of a very common word
